name: static_multiset_build_count_each_i32
description: Build a cuCollections-style static multiset from an int32 build relation, then count the build-side multiplicity of every probe key across shared database-state distributions. Candidate latency is GPU build+count-each activity; input generation, host allocation, and wrapper latency are excluded.

build_size.description: Number of rows in the build relation, including duplicate keys.

unique_keys.description: Exact number of distinct keys in the build relation.

hit_rate_percent.description: Exact percentage of probes whose keys occur in the build relation, rounded down to a whole probe count.

zipf_alpha_milli.description: Key-frequency skew: 0 is uniform and, for example, 1250 means Zipf alpha 1.25.

build_keys.description: Build-relation keys with the requested cardinality and skew; INT32_MIN is reserved as the empty-key sentinel.

probe_keys.description: Probe keys with the requested hit rate and skew.

match_counts.description: For each probe key, the number of matching rows in build_keys.
